def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The task uses a uniform separator between equally sized panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
    panel_w = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    left = [row[sep-panel_w:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:sep+1+panel_w] for row in grid]
    common = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    base = next(iter(common))
    out = [[base] * panel_w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(panel_w):
            if left[r][c] == base and right[r][c] == base:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
PY
